dataset.name: Evidence Inference 2.0 official validation split
dataset.access: public download; no registration or data-access approval required
dataset.scope: article-disjoint cross-domain validation of the frozen QASPER sentence-chunking result; same Evidence Inference benchmark family as a previously explored test subset, so not an independent benchmark family
dataset.article_sample: include all validation article IDs satisfying int(SHA256('evidence-watchdog-ev2val-20261016:' + PMCID)[0:8], 16) modulo 4 == 0; this source-article sample rule is fixed without using annotations or model outcomes; include every eligible prompt and valid annotator rationale for sampled articles
dataset.overlap_rule: verify zero overlap with the official Evidence Inference train and test article-ID lists and with the previously evaluated 94 test articles

question: Does sentence-preserving subdivision of over-budget paragraphs improve visibility of annotator-accepted rationale spans under a fixed display-token budget in held-out biomedical trial articles, and does the long-versus-short source-paragraph trade-off observed in QASPER recur?

cohort.include: all prompts in sampled articles having at least one Valid Label=true and Valid Reasoning=true annotation with in-bounds source offsets
cohort.annotation_handling: group spans by prompt and annotator; combine spans only within the same annotator; score each annotator rationale separately, average annotator scores within prompt, then average prompts
cohort.prompt: official outcome/intervention/comparator fields, rendered with the frozen wording used in the prior Evidence Inference audit
cohort.source_offsets: inclusive character offsets from the official annotation CSV; convert to half-open intervals for computation

candidate_units.baseline: nonempty original source paragraphs parsed using the frozen double-newline block rule and original source offsets
candidate_units.treatment: paragraphs at or below 240 BGE-token units remain intact; longer paragraphs greedily group adjacent complete sentences with PySBD 0.3.4 English char-span mode, no cleaning, no overlap, offsets retained; over-cap single sentences remain intact and are flagged; if invalid/overlapping offsets occur, retain the source paragraph unsplit and flag fallback
candidate_units.selector_inputs: same outcome/intervention/comparator query for both unitizations
candidate_units.tokenizer: locally cached BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 fast tokenizer; source-unit token cost excludes query and special tokens

packing.policy: descending selector score, earlier source position breaks ties, retain whole units that fit and skip units that do not

outcomes.primary: per-prompt mean across annotators of source-character recall over accepted rationale spans at 240 tokens
outcomes.primary_contrast: BGE sentence-preserving chunks minus original paragraphs, paired within prompt and clustered by source article
secondary: rationale visibility split by original source paragraphs >240 versus <=240 BGE tokens
outcomes.interpretation_boundary: annotator-accepted rationale visibility; not exhaustive evidence sufficiency, clinical inference accuracy, user comprehension, or decision quality

uncertainty.cluster: source article PMCID; preserve all sampled prompts and annotators per sampled article
uncertainty.primary_test: two-sided 95% interval for the 240-token BGE chunk-minus-paragraph character-recall contrast; no tuning on this sample

reproducibility.article_sample_manifest: save sampled source IDs and selection hashes before scoring
reproducibility.redistribution: do not redistribute source article text; check article-specific PMC reuse terms before any public packaging
reproducibility.reporting: report all exclusions, overlap checks, and all prespecified outcomes, including null or adverse results
